params.diag_line_density_divergence_definition: DIAG_LINE_DENSITY_DIVERGENCE = max(rho_k)-mean(rho_k) over off-diagonal diagonals k!=0 with >=1 qualifying diagonal run of consecutive 1s (length >= l_min=2); rho_k = (sum of qualifying run lengths l>=l_min on diagonal k) / (number of cells on diagonal k in embedded RP = M_pts-|k|). params.gap_definition: gap length w = number of consecutive 0-cells between successive recurrent points in a column (excluding trivial self at i==j)
